description: This file defines a custom Android View class 'LogView' that extends TextView and implements the LogNode interface. It is used to display log data received through the logging system, formatting log entries and outputting them to the UI, and supporting linked list chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView component that displays log messages, formatted with priority, tags, message, and exceptions, and supports linking to other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and appends it to the TextView, then passes the data to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append non-null strings with delimiters to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
